open_obligations.what_is_open: A sharp minimax mean-squared-error rate over a precisely defined shrinking-separation triangular class, a data-driven selector attaining that rate across ordinary DML, finite-order ACE, and global-contour regimes, a specified uniformly valid confidence procedure, and a matching local minimax lower bound remain undetermined.
open_obligations.obstruction: The current node explicitly defines a research agenda rather than a formal existence claim: neither a unique sharp-rate functional nor a uniform-inference/coverage criterion is defined. Its frozen dependencies establish a matched fixed-separation rate and two shrinking-separation upper benchmarks, but they supply no selector, confidence procedure, or full-class local converse from which the requested joint conclusion could be derived.
open_obligations.attempted: The ordinary-DML and local-ACE guarantees can be combined only into a pointwise oracle minimum, which is not a data-driven rule. The fixed-separation contour argument is not uniform as the separation vanishes because its localization radius, contour certificate, and risk constant depend on the fixed separation. The Gaussian--Rademacher calculation supplies only a path-specific upper bound and therefore cannot certify a full-class minimax rate or matching lower bound.
